response.justification: Bogdan is a capable Staff-level software engineer with strong TypeScript and Node.js expertise, currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq. However, he falls significantly short of the core requirement of 8+ years developing production-grade AI solutions. Critical gaps include: no Python (essential for AI/ML work), no demonstrated experience with vector databases or RAG architectures, minimal evidence of data pipeline work for AI systems, and only ~16 months in AI-focused roles. While his recent pivot toward GenAI is promising and his engineering fundamentals are solid, the resume lacks the sustained AI/ML expertise expected for a Staff-level position.
strengths: Staff-level engineer with mastery of TypeScript/Node.js and currently building AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow frameworks
Proven ability to architect and deliver across full-stack domains (backend, infrastructure, DevOps) with experience at high-scale systems (millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby)
Strong technical leadership track record including mentoring, technical talks, and workshop creation; demonstrates communication skills needed for customer-facing technical leadership
concerns: Python not listed despite being standard for AI/ML; 8+ years AI requirement not met—only ~16 months in AI-focused role with previous career in general software engineering
No evidence of vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM performance optimization, or data pipeline expertise for AI systems—all critical to the role
Lack of concrete examples shipping production-grade AI solutions; current AI work is very recent and insufficient to validate the 8+ years of AI-driven solution development required
